question: Should nix-openclaw document the current `allowRequestSessionKey` workaround now, or wait and expose the planned pull-model Gmail integration as the supported public interface?
rationale: The discussion establishes both a working compatibility setting and a collaborator-sponsored replacement direction; selecting the stable user-facing Nix contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship the pull-model integration
options.body: Implement and document the planned first-class pull-model interface once the upstream contract is ready, retaining only necessary compatibility behavior.

options.title: Document the current workaround
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped public configuration example for the existing hook setting while treating pull-model support as separate follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Ship the pull-model integration
recommendation.body: Implement and document the planned first-class pull-model interface once the upstream contract is ready, retaining only necessary compatibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They explicitly coordinated the linked upstream work and stated that the Nix integration would follow it.
